sections.title: Owner costs
sections.sql: select month,centre,owner,currency,billed_amount,effective_amount from monthly_spend order by month,centre,currency

sections.title: Budget exceptions
sections.sql: select month,centre,currency,budget_amount,actual_amount,variance_amount,finding from budget_review where finding<>'within budget' order by month,centre

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,reference

sections.title: Cost per recorded unit
sections.sql: select * from unit_costs order by month,centre,currency,unit
sections.note: Units are supplied by the operator. Currency is never converted.
